audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Olaf the 2+ items row while the prose on the same page said 'Late is finally yours as Olaf falls off'. Levels 4-5 and First item were marked Skill on this side but Olaf on the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirror (olaf__yone) settled it as Olaf through first item, Yone at two-plus items — which is also what whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] already said here. Reckless Swing is true damage on a 7-11s cooldown and his passive scales lifesteal off missing health, so the pre-item rows are his; his falloff is what hands Yone the last row.
audit.corrected: Rows 4-5 and First item set to Olaf, 2+ items set to Yone, matched full/content pairs with ratings, and the two phases[].why lines rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undertow, Reckless Swing and Ragnarok were all discussed without a cooldown, so 'engage on his cooldown' had no clock at any point in the page.
audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s that RESETS if he picks the axe up — that reset is the actual reason his aggression feels endless, and nothing said it. Ragnarok is 80-100s, the longest window in the lane.
audit.corrected: Undertow's 9s and its pickup reset written into dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[1].d; Ragnarok's 80-100s into dosFull[2].d; Reckless Swing's true damage tied to the first-item row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two content fields told the player to Windwall Olaf's axe. Yone has no Wind Wall — that is Yasuo. Fate Sealed was also described as setting up knockups in phases[4].why and breakdown.late; it is a blink behind the last champion in a line plus a pull, and the knockup is Mortal Steel's second-stack cast.
audit.why: Riot ability text in the brief. A Yone player who plans around a wall he does not have eats a 1000-range slow instead of sidestepping it.
audit.corrected: Windwall replaced with sidestepping the 1000-range Undertow; Fate Sealed restated as blink-behind-and-pull without touching the unresolved Ragnarok question below.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Undertow with grounding ('shuts off enemy dashes'), which Riot's description does not support — the axe deals damage and reduces Armor and Move Speed, nothing more.
audit.why: Where a derived flag contradicts Riot's description, the description wins. The page's existing 'slow' wording is correct and was left as is.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim written. Flagged so the flag can be fixed at source.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ragnarok's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Olaf's window: Reckless Swing's true damage every 7-11s plus missing-health lifesteal out-trades you. Farm safe, refuse the brawl.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ragnarok's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King helps, but Reckless Swing is true damage — duel only once his axe is on the ground.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Olaf's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind the line and pulls; it is not a knockup. Ragnarok's disable immunity still changes the math at 6.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge — build your teamfight around that. Olaf carry threat: 8/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind their back line and pulls it to you — build your teamfight around that. Olaf carry threat: 8/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

edits.before: Stack to Q3, soul-E in when Olaf's answer is down, dump Q3-W-AA, and snap back before he can re-engage.
edits.after: Undertow is a 1000-range throw on 9s, and picking the axe up resets it — path away from where it lands.

edits.before: Olaf wastes Ragnarok — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Ragnarok is 80-100s, and his lifesteal grows as his health drops.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A picked-up Undertow refunds its 9s cooldown — never walk over the axe.

edits.before: You finally scale past him — Olaf falls off hard, and your E-window kiting plus Windwall on his axe means late 1v1s and teamfights swing to your DPS and mobility.
edits.after: You finally scale past him — Olaf falls off hard, and Soul Unbound kiting plus sidestepping the 1000-range axe swings late 1v1s and teamfights to your DPS.

edits.before: The matchup flips to you late — Olaf's power drops off a cliff while your items and E-window kiting take over. Windwall his axe, respect nothing once Ragnarok is on cooldown, and out-DPS him in every extended fight.
edits.after: The matchup flips to you late — Olaf's power drops off a cliff while your items and Soul Unbound kiting take over. Sidestep the axe instead of eating the slow, respect nothing once Ragnarok is down, and out-DPS him.

notes: Third page in this slice with the Windwall error — the content layer told a Yone player to Windwall Undertow. Yone has no Wind Wall. LEFT ALONE DELIBERATELY: whys[4] and spikes[1] claim Fate Sealed's pull cannot hold Olaf during Ragnarok. Riot's text says only 'immune to disables' and does not state whether a pull counts, and the mirror flagged the same gap — see questionsForUser. Undertow's grounding flag is a tooltip-parse misfire.
